subject: general
question: A person walks 8 km north, then 6 km west, and finally 8 km south. In which direction is he from his starting point?
solution:
8 km north

6 km west

8 km south

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bfec6eb29153196cd8c53727da85faad425614c2e851ebc70861cc7b5e9d45.png] 

Opposite directions cancel each other

Vertical movement = 8 − 8 = 0

⇒ Net vertical distance = 0

Horizontal movement = 6 km west

⇒ Net position from starting point = 6 km west

**∴ He is in the West direction from the starting point.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 4.**
